title: Listing photo data: US real estate photography prices, MLS photo rules and listing photo tools
description:
Open data about real estate listing photos, published by October (october-ai.com/data).

  • Real estate photography prices: published prices of 154 US real estate photographers and photo companies in 24 metros, by home size, with drone, video, twilight and 3D tour add-ons. Each row links to the business's own pricing page and the date it was read (3 November 2026).
  • MLS photo rules: photo limits, required shots, branding bans, virtual-staging labels, AI rules and fines at 22 US MLSs, each from the MLS's own published rules.
  • Listing photo apps and services: 58 capture apps, AI editors, editing services, virtual staging, 3D tour and video tools, with price basis, lowest published price and turnaround, each from the vendor's own pages.
  • Professional listing photo benchmarks: 26 measured figures (vertical lean, focal length, brightness profile, saturation, detail) with sample size and method.

CSV and JSON. Each JSON file carries its own field list, licence and changelog. Cite as: Source: October, october-ai.com/data.
